zh.title: 2026飛航安全管理國際峯會登場 民航局盼三面向提升韌性
zh.summary: 民航局舉辦2026飛安峯會；首度連續兩日；約200位專家與會
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，「2026年飛航安全管理國際峯會」今日正式登場，會中邀集約200位專家及高階主管與會。
民航局指出，本次峯會擴大國際交流，首度連續舉辦兩日。
民航局說明，邀集對象包括前ICAO專家Mr. Simon ROBERTS、IATA高階主管Mr. Stuart FOX及世界飛安基金會Capt. Jose FERNANDEZ、新加坡航空Capt. Eugene C. ANTONI、全日空Capt. Max MATSUMOTO、波音Mr. Erik LANGHOFER，以及國內航發會、運安會與各國籍航空公司、維修廠等。
交通部次長林國顯致詞時勉勵航空界「每一個人都是飛安的領導者與負責人」。
民航局長何淑萍則希望航空界從深化風險管理、深化安全文化、跨組織合作提升韌性等三面向，進一步提升飛航安全。

en.title: Taiwan aviation safety summit opens; CAA points to three areas for resilience
en.summary: CAA Taiwan opens 2026 aviation safety summit; first two-day run; about 200 experts attend
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration said the 2026 International Flight Safety Management Summit opened, bringing together about 200 experts and senior executives.
The administration said the summit expands international exchange and is being held over two consecutive days for the first time.

According to the administration, participants include former ICAO expert Mr. Simon ROBERTS, IATA senior executive Mr. Stuart FOX, Flight Safety Foundation Capt. Jose FERNANDEZ, Singapore Airlines Capt. Eugene C. ANTONI, All Nippon Airways Capt. Max MATSUMOTO and Boeing's Mr. Erik LANGHOFER, along with domestic foundations, the Taiwan Transportation Safety Board, national carriers and maintenance organisations.
Speaking at the event, Deputy Minister of Transportation and Communications Lin Kuo-hsien told the aviation community that "everyone is a leader and owner of flight safety."

Civil Aeronautics Administration Director-General Ho Shu-ping said she hopes the industry will further improve flight safety in three areas: deepening risk management, deepening safety culture, and cross-organisation cooperation to raise resilience.

zh.summary: Chicago Midway關閉一條跑道一個月，維修影響料及西南航空
body: Simple Flying報導，Chicago Midway一條跑道關閉一個月。報導標題提及「jet blast damage」，並在跑道關閉的描述中提到這項損壞；標題沒有提供損壞細節。
報導摘要指出，相關維修預計對營運造成顯著影響，尤其是西南航空。這項敘述表達的是維修帶來營運影響的預期，沒有表示影響已經發生；摘要亦未列出營運影響的具體數字。

en.title: Chicago Midway Closes One Runway for a Month; Repairs Expected to Affect Southwest
en.summary: Chicago Midway closes one runway for a month; repairs are expected to affect Southwest Airlines.
body: Simple Flying reports that Chicago Midway has shut one runway for a month. Its headline mentions “jet blast damage” in connection with the runway closure. The stated duration is one month, and the closure concerns one runway.

The report’s summary says repairs are set to have a significant impact on operations, particularly at Southwest Airlines. That impact is presented as expected, rather than as a measured operational result. The summary also identifies repairs as the development associated with the anticipated effects.

zh.title: 烏克蘭第92獨立突擊旅稱以重型無人機撤離傷兵
zh.summary: 烏克蘭第92獨立突擊旅稱，以重型無人機撤離一名傷兵。
body: 烏克蘭第92獨立突擊旅在官方Telegram頻道發布訊息，稱一名傷兵已從陣地以無人機撤離。Aerospace Global News報導，該旅選用由Gurzuf Defence打造的重型六旋翼無人機執行任務；報導未提供行動日期或地點。
報導指出，地雷及敵方無人機活動頻繁，使烏軍無法使用無人地面車輛撤離傷兵。第92旅與Gurzuf合作調整無人機，以改善飛行穩定性；發布的影片顯示傷兵自行扣上吊帶，隨後由無人機載離。

en.title: Ukraine's 92nd Brigade reports wounded serviceman evacuated by heavy-lift drone
en.summary: Ukraine’s 92nd Brigade says it evacuated a wounded serviceman by heavy-lift drone.
body: Ukraine’s 92nd Separate Assault Brigade posted on its official Telegram channel that a wounded serviceman had been evacuated from a position by aerial drone. Aerospace Global News reported that the brigade used a heavy-lift hexacopter built by Gurzuf Defence. The report did not disclose the operation’s date or location.

The report said mines and high activity by enemy drones in the area prevented Ukrainian forces from using unmanned ground vehicles to evacuate the serviceman. The 92nd worked with Gurzuf to modify the drone for greater stability in the air. Released video shows the wounded soldier attaching himself to a harness before flying out of harm’s way.
